info.title: Qorstack Report API
info.description: API for generating PDF reports from Word templates

post.description: Upload a font (.ttf, .otf, .woff, .woff2). If the same file already exists (by hash), the existing font is returned without re-uploading.

get.description: Returns all active fonts available to every project.
For each uploaded font: "ready" (the renderer can use it), "syncing" (stored, still being copied to the renderer) or "error" (missing from storage).

delete.description: Permanently removes the font from the database, MinIO storage, and Gotenberg cache.

post.summary: Render Word/PDF from stored template (returns link)
post.description: Render a PDF or DOCX from a stored Word template. Supports variable replacement, tables, images, QR codes and barcodes. Set templateVersion to render an older stored version. Returns a download link.

429.description: Too many unfinished async renders for this user (Retry-After header)

post.summary: Render PDF from template using sandbox payload (returns link)
post.description: Render a PDF using a stored template with its configured sandbox payload. Returns download link.

post.summary: Render Excel from stored template (returns link)
post.description: Render an .xlsx file from a stored .xlsx template (Excel in, Excel out). Supports variable replacement, tables, images, QR codes and barcodes. Set templateVersion to render an older stored version. Returns a download link.

429.description: Too many unfinished async renders for this user (Retry-After header)

get.description: Get a list of render jobs with pagination and filtering options.
Get details of a specific render job by its ID.

post.description: Create a new report generation job with hybrid quota charging (subscription first, then credit fallback).

get.description: Retrieve report jobs for the authenticated user.

post.description: Upload a template file (DOCX or XLSX). Name is required via query parameter, file is required via multipart form data.

put.summary: Switch active version of a template
put.description: Switch the active version of a template to a specified version number.

get.summary: Generate a new unique template key
get.description: Generates a unique template key for the current user.

get.summary: Export the project as a ZIP (Pro)
get.description: Latest active version of every template, its saved test data and builder images, and uploaded fonts. API keys, members and history are not included.

post.description: dryRun=true returns the plan without changing anything. New templates are created with the same key, newer versions are added, equal or older versions are skipped.

templateVersion.description: Render this stored version of the template. Omit for the current version.

async.description: Pro: queue the render and return 202 with a job id instead of the file. Poll GET /render/jobs/{jobId} or set webhookUrl.

webhookUrl.description: With async: true, receives a POST {jobId, status, downloadUrl?, expiresIn?, error?} when the job finishes. Signed with X-Qorstack-Signature when the server has a signing secret.

columns.description: Column marker names ({{row:name}}), listed once, in the order of the row values. Unique.

rows.description: Rows; each row is an array of cell values in the order of columns, e.g. [["A", 2]]

items.description: Cell value: string, number, boolean or null

fit.description: How the image fills its box: cover, contain (default) or fill
